$Comment: One piece of the Nightwarden set, claimed from the Night Owl achievement ladder. Parent is the vanilla Armor_Cobalt_Chest, so the durability and sounds are inherited and only the fields below are this item's own. No Recipe: a recipe is never inherited through Parent, so the set can only be earned. LOOK. Icon/Model/Texture/IconProperties are overridden onto the vanilla Onyxium chest armor's own values in place of the inherited Cobalt look, a dark obsidian-flavored reskin borrowed whole from an existing vanilla art set rather than new art. Each of these four is an ordinary top-level field, not a full-object-replace block, so overriding one leaves the rest exactly as authored. THE ARMOR BLOCK IS FULL-OBJECT-REPLACE. Authoring it at all means the WHOLE object has to be written out, so ArmorSlot, BaseDamageResistance, CosmeticsToHide, DamageResistance, StatModifiers and DamageClassEnhancement are all restated verbatim from the parent below; leave any one of them out and that behaviour silently disappears. Five lines are this piece's own addition. MMO_SchoolResist_Void 6 is 6 percentage points less damage taken from Void-school hits, a percent-family channel where the Amount IS the percent, Additive because the channel carries a base of zero and a Multiplicative-only entry there would compute zero. MMO_Bonus_Void 2 is the offense side of the same school, plus 2 percentage points of Void-school damage dealt, on the same Additive footing and stacking with the longsword's own 8 while this piece is worn, so the full set nudges Void damage output as well as resisting it. Note both are a different mechanism from the native DamageResistance map above, which is authored in fractions (0.064 is 6.4 percent); all three stack independently. Health carries ONE Additive entry of 32, already summing this piece's own bonus with the vanilla parent's base amount, so the tooltip prints a single number instead of two lines a player would have to add up themselves. Mana 1 raises the wearer's mana pool by 1 while worn; Mana's own base Max is 0, so this is real usable mana that stacks across the set rather than a bonus on an existing pool. Stamina 2 raises the wearer's stamina pool by 2 while worn; unlike Mana, Stamina already carries a real vanilla base (Max 10), so this piece's line adds straight onto that base rather than being the pool's only source, and it is the one piece of the set that grants it. Wear all three and the set's Void resistance, Void damage, mana and health all add up across the pieces. Every number here is balance and safe to retune.
